title: Very good value for money – Pip W

post.title: Very good value for money – Pip W
post.html: Good place to get together with a group friends as lots of separate cottages. Great ensuite rooms with good showers. Nicely furnished but kitchen equipment needed sorting out a bit. One niggle was a very strong smell of moth balls or similar in one room which we could not track down the source of and think it just have been in the carpet, that was a shame as it meant the occupant of that room didn’t sleep very well.
